cases.prompt: Use wa for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Build a feature-to-test matrix with isolated fixtures, role ownership checks, failure recovery, and observable deployment evidence.
Exercise authorization denial, idempotency, queues, uploads, UI states, accessibility, and provider-disabled mode.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use wa with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use wa with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Improve contextual banners and spatial UI with mobile, keyboard, contrast, and performance checks.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
